I don’t have live access to current weather data. If you share a link or screenshot, I can interpret it. Otherwise, here are quick ways to check Berlin’s weather now:
- Visit wttr.in/Berlin (simple text forecast)
- Search “Berlin weather” on weather.com or Google
- On a terminal: curl "https://wttr.in/Berlin?format=3"

If you enable web access or provide a source, I can fetch and summarize it for you.
